lines.zh: 我一步一步量着草地，爪印却比脚多。
lines.en: I measure the grass step by step, and my prints outnumber my feet.

lines.zh: 我的脑袋一前一后地探，像在点头。
lines.en: My head juts forward and back, as if nodding.

lines.zh: 走过你的门槛时，我会停半秒。
lines.en: Crossing your doorstep, I pause for half a second.

lines.zh: 我在干草上留下爪痕，方向朝后。
lines.en: I leave claw marks in the hay, all pointing backwards.

lines.zh: 每一步都轻得像纸片落地。
lines.en: Every step lands light as a scrap of paper.

lines.zh: 我绕过鸡舍，却从另一边先到。
lines.en: I go around the coop and reach the far side first.

lines.zh: 我的影子走得比我快半步。
lines.en: My shadow walks half a step ahead of me.

lines.zh: 草地被我的爪子划出一排细线。
lines.en: My claws scratch a row of thin lines into the lawn.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，脖子却一直转。
lines.en: I walk slowly, yet my neck keeps turning.

lines.zh: 你在前面走，我跟在后头数你的脚步。
lines.en: You walk ahead; I follow, counting your steps.

lines.zh: 我的腿细得像竹签，走起来咔哒作响。
lines.en: My legs are thin as skewers and click as I go.

lines.zh: 我沿着栅栏走，从不跨过去。
lines.en: I walk along the fence and never cross it.

lines.zh: 泥地上有我走过的路，来回只有一行。
lines.en: The mud shows my trail, one line only, both ways.

lines.zh: 我走着走着，会突然停在原地侧头。
lines.en: Mid-stride I stop dead and tilt my head.

lines.zh: 我踩过你的脚印，把它们盖成鸡爪。
lines.en: I step in your footprints and stamp them into claws.

lines.zh: 天色暗下来，我的步子却更稳了。
lines.en: As the light fails, my gait grows steadier.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，脖子偶尔抽一下。
lines.en: I stand still, my neck twitching now and then.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不眨，只是换个角度看你。
lines.en: I never blink; I only change the angle I watch you from.

lines.zh: 风把羽毛吹开，底下什么也没有。
lines.en: The wind parts my feathers, and there is nothing beneath.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，像在听你身后的声音。
lines.en: I tilt my head, listening to something behind you.

lines.zh: 我的喙一张一合，没有声音出来。
lines.en: My beak opens and closes without a sound.

lines.zh: 我呆立着，胸口起伏得太规律。
lines.en: I stand frozen, my chest rising too evenly.

lines.zh: 我可以这样站一整天，不用吃。
lines.en: I could stand like this all day without eating.

lines.zh: 我盯着鸡舍的角落，那里没人。
lines.en: I stare at the corner of the coop, where nobody is.

lines.zh: 羽毛落了一地，我一根都没掉。
lines.en: Feathers lie everywhere, yet I have lost none.

lines.zh: 我把自己折起来，像一把收好的伞。
lines.en: I fold myself up like a closed umbrella.

lines.zh: 我不啄食，只是把地啄出小坑。
lines.en: I do not feed; I only peck little holes in the dirt.

lines.zh: 我安静得让你听见自己的呼吸。
lines.en: I am so quiet you can hear your own breathing.

lines.zh: 我站着睡觉，一只眼始终朝你。
lines.en: I sleep standing, one eye always on you.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓着地面，抓得很深。
lines.en: My claws grip the ground, and they grip deep.

lines.zh: 我偶尔抖一下，像画面卡住了。
lines.en: I twitch at intervals, like a picture catching.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚出一声不像鸡的咕噜。
lines.en: A rumble rolls from my throat, not quite a chicken's.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，用两只眼一起对准你。
lines.en: I lift my head and aim both eyes at you at once.

lines.zh: 我把脖子拉得很长，长到不合理。
lines.en: I stretch my neck out, further than it should go.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来时，我也蹲下，保持一样高。
lines.en: When you crouch, I crouch too, keeping level with you.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔里映出你，慢了一拍。
lines.en: Your reflection sits in my eye a beat too late.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我歪头，脖子先动。
lines.en: When you look at me, I tilt my head; my neck moves first.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我的头跟着转一步。
lines.en: You step back once and my head turns once.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只是把喙对着你。
lines.en: I make no sound, only point my beak at you.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处泛出一点白。
lines.en: In the dark my eyes give off a little white.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，像在确认什么。
lines.en: I look at you a long while, as if confirming something.

lines.zh: 你转头时，我的头已经先转过来了。
lines.en: When you turn, my head has already turned first.

lines.zh: 我侧着脑袋，把你看成两半。
lines.en: I cock my head and split you into two halves.

lines.zh: 我们的视线撞上，你比我先移开。
lines.en: Our gazes meet, and you look away before I do.

lines.zh: 我仰头看你，喉咙动了一下。
lines.en: I look up at you and my throat moves once.

lines.zh: 你开口说话，我的头跟着声音偏。
lines.en: You speak, and my head leans toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，屋里的鸡都不叫了。
lines.en: While I watch you, every chicken in the coop goes silent.

lines.zh: 我被打得歪倒，又慢慢正过来。
lines.en: The blow knocks me crooked, and I slowly straighten.

lines.zh: 我掉了几根羽毛，下面还是羽毛。
lines.en: A few feathers fall, and beneath them, more feathers.

lines.zh: 我尖叫一声，那声音太像人。
lines.en: I shriek once, and the sound is far too human.

lines.zh: 我退开两步，血是暗的。
lines.en: I back off two steps, and my blood is dark.

lines.zh: 我受伤后不动了，只是看着你。
lines.en: Wounded, I stop moving and simply watch you.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，伤口没有流血。
lines.en: I shake myself, and the wound does not bleed.

lines.zh: 我踉跄着跑开，跑得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: I stagger away, running crookedly.

lines.zh: 我的脖子软下去，又硬撑起来。
lines.en: My neck goes limp, then forces itself up.

lines.zh: 我挨了一下，叫得整个院子都听见。
lines.en: I take the hit and cry loud enough for the whole yard.

lines.zh: 我趴在地上，翅膀还在抽动。
lines.en: I lie on the ground, my wings still twitching.

lines.zh: 你手里的种子让我往前挪了一寸。
lines.en: The seeds in your hand pull me forward an inch.

lines.zh: 我盯着种子，喉咙里发出细响。
lines.en: I fix on the seeds, a thin noise in my throat.

lines.zh: 我啄你掌心，力道不太对。
lines.en: I peck your palm, with slightly the wrong force.

lines.zh: 种子撒下，我第一个到，别的鸡还没动。
lines.en: The seeds fall and I arrive first, before the others move.

lines.zh: 我低头啄食，眼睛一直抬着看你。
lines.en: I peck at the ground, eyes still lifted to you.

lines.zh: 你摊开手掌，我把整张脸埋进去。
lines.en: You open your palm and I bury my whole face in it.

lines.zh: 我不抢，只是站在种子中间全吃掉。
lines.en: I do not fight; I stand among the seeds and eat them all.

lines.zh: 我追着你的手走，忘了脚下的路。
lines.en: I follow your hand and forget the ground I walk on.

lines.zh: 种子在土里，我连土一起啄起来。
lines.en: The seeds are in the dirt, so I peck up dirt as well.

lines.zh: 我吃得很慢，像在数每一粒。
lines.en: I eat slowly, as if counting every grain.

lines.zh: 你把种子举高，我就伸长脖子够。
lines.en: You raise the seeds, so I stretch my neck to reach.

lines.zh: 我吞下种子，喉咙鼓起一个小包。
lines.en: I swallow, and a small lump slides down my throat.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，那里也有种子味。
lines.en: I circle behind you, where the seeds also smell.

lines.zh: 我对麦粒的兴趣不如对你手指的兴趣。
lines.en: I am less interested in the wheat than in your fingers.

lines.zh: 我啄了一下你的指甲，然后装作在吃。
lines.en: I peck your nail once, then pretend to be eating.

lines.zh: 你手一收，我的头跟着往前追。
lines.en: You pull your hand back and my head chases it.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的小腿，骨头轻得没感觉。
lines.en: I bump your shin, my bones so light you feel nothing.

lines.zh: 你踢开我，我又贴回来。
lines.en: You kick me aside and I press back against you.

lines.zh: 我卡在你和墙之间，不躲也不让。
lines.en: I wedge between you and the wall, not dodging, not yielding.

lines.zh: 我的身体撞上来，像一团湿羽毛。
lines.en: I hit you like a bundle of wet feathers.

lines.zh: 你推我，我的脚在地上滑出声音。
lines.en: You push me and my feet scrape across the floor.

lines.zh: 我从你腿间挤过去，羽毛蹭了你一裤。
lines.en: I squeeze between your legs and leave feathers on your trousers.

lines.zh: 我撞到栅栏，木头响了一声，我没响。
lines.en: I hit the fence; the wood sounds, I do not.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你听见轻轻的咔。
lines.en: We collide, and you hear a small click.

lines.zh: 我被你撞翻，翻身站起来还是那个姿势。
lines.en: Knocked over, I right myself in exactly the same pose.

lines.zh: 你后退撞到我，我的体温低得吓人。
lines.en: You back into me, and my body is frighteningly cold.

lines.zh: 另一只鸡走过来，动作和我一样僵。
lines.en: Another chicken approaches, moving as stiffly as I do.

lines.zh: 我们面对面站着，谁也不先动。
lines.en: We stand face to face, neither moving first.

lines.zh: 它啄我的颈羽，我一动不动。
lines.en: It pecks my neck feathers and I do not stir.

lines.zh: 两只鸡凑在一起，没有一声叫。
lines.en: Two chickens come together without a single call.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此转，圈子越来越小。
lines.en: We circle each other, the circle shrinking.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛和我的一样，不眨。
lines.en: Its eyes are like mine, and they do not blink.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀搭上去，羽毛下面很凉。
lines.en: I lay a wing across it; beneath the feathers it is cold.

lines.zh: 我们同时低头，像有人在数拍子。
lines.en: We bow our heads together, as if someone counts the beat.

lines.zh: 我们挨得很近，像在交换什么。
lines.en: We press close, as though trading something.

lines.zh: 完事后它走开，走得像被我操纵。
lines.en: Afterward it walks away as if I were moving it.

lines.zh: 你把我捧起来，我轻得不像活着。
lines.en: You lift me up, and I am too light to be alive.

lines.zh: 我窝在你手里，爪子勾住你的袖子。
lines.en: I settle in your hands, claws hooked in your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你把我塞进背包，我在里面很安静。
lines.en: You tuck me into your pack, and I stay very quiet.

lines.zh: 我贴在你掌心，心跳快得离谱。
lines.en: Against your palm my heartbeat races absurdly.

lines.zh: 你提起我，我的头垂下去又抬起来。
lines.en: You lift me; my head droops, then rises again.

lines.zh: 我待在你手上，眼睛一直看着你下巴。
lines.en: I rest in your hands, eyes fixed on your chin.

lines.zh: 你换手拿我，我的姿势一点没变。
lines.en: You switch hands, and my pose does not change at all.

lines.zh: 我抓紧你的手指，指甲尖得很。
lines.en: I grip your fingers, my nails very sharp.

lines.zh: 你把我放下，我还保持着被捧的形状。
lines.en: You set me down and I keep the shape of your hands.

lines.zh: 你抱起我时，闻到我身上有铁味。
lines.en: When you pick me up, you smell iron on me.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，脖子慢慢压低。
lines.en: I have picked you, and my neck sinks low.

lines.zh: 我选定你的脚踝，先不动。
lines.en: I choose your ankle, and hold still.

lines.zh: 我的头一僵，像是决定了什么。
lines.en: My head stiffens, as if a decision is made.

lines.zh: 你背对我时，我朝你迈出第一步。
lines.en: When your back is turned, I take my first step toward you.

lines.zh: 我锁住你的影子，跟着它移动。
lines.en: I fix on your shadow and move with it.

lines.zh: 我不叫了，这比叫更让人不安。
lines.en: I stop calling, which is worse than the calling.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，露出下面瘦长的骨。
lines.en: I spread my wings and show the long thin bones beneath.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，像要扑又不像。
lines.en: I lower myself, almost as if to pounce.

lines.zh: 目标很近，我的喙微微张开。
lines.en: The target is close, and my beak parts a little.

lines.zh: 我选定你，就不再看别的鸡。
lines.en: Having chosen you, I look at no other chicken.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，隔三步，不快不慢。
lines.en: I follow three steps behind, never faster, never slower.

lines.zh: 你停下，我也停下，头还朝着你。
lines.en: You stop, I stop, my head still toward you.

lines.zh: 我绕到你视线之外，再走回来。
lines.en: I slip out of your sight, then walk back in.

lines.zh: 我的喙对着你的膝盖，一直对着。
lines.en: My beak points at your knee, and keeps pointing.

lines.zh: 你上楼，我在楼梯下仰头等。
lines.en: You climb the stairs; I wait below, looking up.

lines.zh: 我始终保持那个距离，一步不差。
lines.en: I keep that distance exactly, not a step off.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我正低头啄地，装没事。
lines.en: You glance back: I am pecking the ground, innocent.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上刨，声音跟在你后面。
lines.en: My claws scrape the ground, the sound trailing you.

lines.zh: 你跑起来，我的翅膀张开又合上。
lines.en: You run, and my wings open and close.

lines.zh: 我锁着你，连你关门的声音都记着。
lines.en: I hold you, remembering even the sound of your door.

lines.zh: 我啄你的脚踝，一下，就一下。
lines.en: I peck your ankle once, just once.

lines.zh: 我的喙磕在你骨头上，钝钝的。
lines.en: My beak knocks against bone, dull and heavy.

lines.zh: 我跳起来撞你，像扔出一团羽毛。
lines.en: I leap at you like a thrown bundle of feathers.

lines.zh: 我抓你的裤脚，爪子勾进布里。
lines.en: I grab your trouser leg, claws hooked in the cloth.

lines.zh: 我扑你的手，啄在最软的地方。
lines.en: I go for your hand and peck the softest spot.

lines.zh: 我撞你的膝盖，然后退开看你反应。
lines.en: I butt your knee, then step back to watch.

lines.zh: 我啄完就低头，像什么都没发生。
lines.en: Done pecking, I lower my head as if nothing happened.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀拍你脸，喙跟着到。
lines.en: My wing slaps your face and the beak follows.

lines.zh: 我从背后啄你后颈，很轻，但准。
lines.en: I peck your nape from behind, light but precise.

lines.zh: 我一次只啄一下，等你放松再来。
lines.en: One peck at a time; I wait for you to relax.

lines.zh: 我从草堆里站起来，身上没有草。
lines.en: I rise from the haystack with no hay on me.

lines.zh: 鸡群里多了一只，谁也没看见它来。
lines.en: There is one more chicken now, and no one saw it come.

lines.zh: 天刚黑，我出现在你院子的角落。
lines.en: Just after dark I appear in the corner of your yard.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋落地，我先转头找你。
lines.en: The spawn egg lands, and I turn to find you first.

lines.zh: 我从栅栏缝里出来，缝窄得不像能过。
lines.en: I come through a gap in the fence too narrow to pass.

lines.zh: 你听见一声咯咯，四周却没有鸡。
lines.en: You hear a cluck, and there is no chicken anywhere.

lines.zh: 我从屋里走出来，门一直是关的。
lines.en: I walk out of the house, though the door stayed shut.

lines.zh: 我站在你昨天站过的地方，等你。
lines.en: I stand where you stood yesterday, waiting.

lines.zh: 雾散时，我就在那儿，离你很近。
lines.en: When the fog lifts, I am there, very close.

lines.zh: 我从地里钻出来，抖落泥土。
lines.en: I push up out of the earth and shake off the soil.

lines.zh: 鸡舍今晚多了一个影子，没多一只鸡。
lines.en: Tonight the coop has one more shadow and no more chickens.

lines.zh: 我的第一声叫，比鸡叫低一个调。
lines.en: My first call comes a tone lower than a chicken's.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的羽毛，味道像烤肉。
lines.en: Fire catches my feathers, and it smells like roasting meat.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，爪子先着地，还是站不稳。
lines.en: I hit the ground claws first and still cannot stand steady.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛里夹着别的东西。
lines.en: Something else is caught in my feathers.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀飞，羽毛散了一地。
lines.en: The blast throws me, feathers scattering everywhere.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的翅膀，我歪着走路。
lines.en: An arrow passes through my wing and I walk crooked.

lines.zh: 药水泼上来，我的羽毛开始褪色。
lines.en: The potion splashes over me and my feathers fade.

lines.zh: 我饿得站不住，还在啄空地。
lines.en: Too starved to stand, I still peck at bare ground.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，毛里透出白光。
lines.en: The lightning hits me; white shines through my feathers.

lines.zh: 我掉进虚空，叫声被拉得很长。
lines.en: I fall into the void, my call drawn out long.
